name: moneyball
description: Measure what every subagent run cost and whether it worked, then route each job to the cheapest model that does it.
tagline: Pay for the model each job needs: measure every subagent run, graduate repeat work to cheaper models on evidence.

platformNotes.copilot: measures and reports; model routing applies where the subagent tool takes a model argument
platformNotes.cursor: measures and reports (transcripts: Claude Code today); model routing needs a subagent tool with a model argument
